topic: POC data scope and next steps
summary_markdown:
The group discussed the initial planning for a Proof of Concept (POC). [p2] noted that an email was received regarding two potential cities and one mall location. To proceed, [p2] sent an inquiry to Accurat to verify data availability for these locations.
